caption: Figure 1. Irreducible recurrence in four connectomes. Each bar spans a proven floor, from a verified cycle packing, and an achieved ceiling, from an exhibited ordering; the true value lies inside. C. elegans is drawn as a point because its bounds meet exactly, so the quantity is known rather than bracketed. The three upper rows do not overlap and rise with size across two phyla. The adult whole brain reads lower than the central brain it contains because it includes the optic lobes, which are large and strongly feedforward. All at a threshold of two synapses per connection.
